why: A timing-based batting game best dramatizes paying each card-eligible invoice exactly on its due date to capture cashback without paying early or missing the window.
title: Cashback Cricket
subtitle: Swing on the due date and send every eligible bill for cashback.
closing_stat: You captured {score} cashback points by paying right on time.

feature_explainer.headline: Ramp Automated Cashback / Card-Eligible Bill Pay
bullets: Ramp automatically pays card-eligible invoices with the Ramp card right on their due date.
Every eligible bill earns cashback instead of leaving money on the table.
The goal is to pay inside the cashback window without paying early and wasting float.
Miss the window and you lose the cashback.
